_doc: Clash rule registry (P3). Rules are kept in four separate categories: geometric, maintenance, fabrication, code. Geometric rules are engine definitions with no external standard. Every numeric parameter states its provenance. NOTHING here claims SMACNA, IMC, NFPA, NEC or any other code compliance: code-category rules are NOT IMPLEMENTED stubs, and every engine result carries complianceClaim 'NONE'.
label: SYNTHETIC engineering validation rules - representative, illustrative values are assumptions, not sealed design

R-GEO-001.title: Hard intersection of two solid objects (verified for box geometry only)

applicability.requires: both objects EXACT_BOX; otherwise R-GEO-002 applies

R-GEO-002.title: Potential intersection from conservative AABB broad-phase (NOT a verified solid intersection)

applicability.requires: at least one object CONSERVATIVE_AABB (round, non-box, or rotated off 90-degree multiples)

R-GEO-003.title: Near miss (gap within tolerance.nearMissFt, not touching)

R-GEO-004.title: Touching boundary / edge / corner contact within tolerance

R-INS-001.title: Insulation envelope interference (bare cores clear, insulated envelopes overlap)

applicability.requires: at least one object has insulationIn > 0; suppressed when the cores already intersect

source.reference: envelope = core AABB grown by insulationIn on every side

applicability.pairs: equipment with serviceFaces vs any other object

serviceClearanceFt.note: ILLUSTRATIVE. Real clearance comes from the manufacturer submittal and the authority having jurisdiction; no code clearance (e.g. NEC 110.26) is applied or implied.

R-CODE-001.title: Duct/pipe clearance and separation requirements from a model code (SMACNA / IMC / NFPA 90A)

applicability.pairs: none until an applicable edition and section are selected and verified

source.reference: SMACNA HVAC Duct Construction Standards; IMC; NFPA 90A - sections NOT selected

R-CODE-002.title: Fire/smoke damper and rated-assembly penetration requirements (UL 555 / 555S listing, installation instructions)

applicability.pairs: none until the listing and the assembly are identified

source.reference: UL 555 / UL 555S, manufacturer installation instructions - not applied
